sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Knight 360 is a side-scrolling action game where you control a knight who must navigate through levels, fighting off enemies and collecting power-ups along the way. The game's controls are simple yet responsive, allowing you to move your knight left or right using the arrow keys or mouse, and jump or spin to attack enemies using the space bar or a mouse button.

One of the key features of Knight 360 is its spin mechanic. By pressing the spin button, your knight will start spinning rapidly, allowing you to deflect arrows and other projectiles that come your way. This mechanic is incredibly useful, especially when facing enemies that fire arrows at you from a distance. In addition, the game's collision detection is spot on, making it easy to navigate through levels without getting stuck or dying due to poor collision detection.

In terms of progression, Knight 360 has a clear level structure, with each level becoming progressively harder as you advance. You'll need to collect power-ups and coins to unlock new levels and upgrade your knight's abilities. The game also features a variety of enemies, from basic skeletons and ghosts to more complex foes like giant spiders and dragons.

Overall, the game's core mechanics are well-designed and easy to learn, making it accessible to players of all skill levels.
